memory_update.text: SPSC should be tracked as a hidden retail operating-system candidate: its exposure is less about consumer demand directly and more about supplier onboarding, EDI, retail compliance, order visibility, and trading-partner switching costs.

ODC is a niche private-label/value-staples materials candidate via lightweight cat litter and absorbent mineral supply; verify customer concentration and private-label mix before promoting beyond Layer 1.

SXT belongs in a regulated-input watchlist for private-label food reformulation, but the private-label linkage is currently indirect and requires primary evidence from filings, segment commentary, and customer/use-case disclosures.

The direct public pure-play private-label food co-manufacturing bucket became thinner after TreeHouse Foods completed its take-private transaction on February 11, 2026; future searches should look for remaining listed co-manufacturers, packaging suppliers, and ingredient firms one step away from store-brand production.

node: Private-label, value-channel, club, off-price, and discount retail enablers
summary: Layer 1B expansion focused on scarce suppliers, infrastructure, regulated inputs, and capacity-constrained enablers behind private-label and value retail. The strongest underfollowed candidates found in this pass are not retailers themselves, but retailer/supplier network software, food-and-grocery distribution infrastructure, regulated ingredient inputs for reformulation, and niche private-label staple materials. TreeHouse Foods would have been a direct private-label co-manufacturing reference, but it completed a take-private transaction on February 11, 2026, so it is excluded from the US-listed candidate list and retained only as a coverage-gap signal.
